sources.primary_title: Salam announces strategic sponsorship of LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: Salam, a prominent Saudi telecommunications and digital infrastructure provider, has announced its strategic sponsorship of LEAP 2026, scheduled for August 31 to September 3 in Riyadh. Operating under the theme 'Powering What's Next', Salam is transitioning from a traditional connectivity provider to a comprehensive technology partner. At the event, Salam will showcase its 'Connectivity+' vision, featuring an expansive portfolio of cloud, connectivity, and AI-enabled infrastructure solutions. Key demonstrations include Industry 4.0 smart manufacturing with an IIoT-enabled command center, AI-powered healthcare diagnostics, and real-time fleet management digital twins. The showcase emphasizes Salam's commitment to enabling Saudi Arabia's digital transformation and supporting Vision 2030 through scalable, purpose-driven technological innovations across multiple sectors including healthcare, mobility, and security.
